intro: Myanmar has about 55 million people and more than 130 officially recognised ethnic groups.

chapters.title: Many peoples
text: The Bamar (Burman) majority lives mainly in the central plains. Shan, Karen, Rakhine, Mon, Chin, Kachin and many others live in the hills and borderlands. Burmese is the official language.
Most people are Theravada Buddhist, and many boys spend time as novice monks.

chapters.title: Daily life
text: Many people wear thanaka, a pale paste made from bark, on their cheeks as sunscreen and decoration.
